task.title: Render file-structure drift in CodeWiki UI
task.summary: Present TASK-010 intended/current file-structure drift data in an existing CodeWiki UI or status surface for human review.

goal.outcome: Maintainers can review intended structure, current structure, approved migration deltas, and actionable file-structure drift through an existing human-visible CodeWiki surface.
acceptance: The surface consumes generated graph/status/audit drift data rather than duplicating file-structure truth.
Approved migration deltas are visually/report-wise separate from actionable drift.
Source paths and canonical refs are available for every displayed claim.
No new user-facing command is added unless existing UI/status surfaces cannot host the data safely.
Existing public package behavior remains compatible.
non_goals: Do not make generated UI output canonical truth.
Do not add a broad new product mode beyond the review surface.

next_loop.reason: The next gateway must independently validate implementation evidence and cite checked content proof.

closure_brief.user_intent: Continue next roadmap task by rendering file-structure drift data in an existing CodeWiki human review surface.
implemented_changes: Added /api/state file_structure model sourced from generated graph/status/audit file-structure evidence.
Rendered Status surface card and four review lanes for intended structure, current structure, approved migration deltas, and actionable drift.
Exposed source refs at row and section level so displayed claims link back to generated graph/audit/map refs.
Added control-room smoke coverage for file-structure model, API response, UI assets, and approved/actionable separation.
Aligned TASK-013 code_paths from missing tests/features to existing tests/smoke/control-room.test.mjs.
acceptance_evidence: Status UI text contains File-structure review, Approved migration deltas, and Actionable drift.
Control-room smoke asserts approved/actionable arrays remain separate and source refs include file-structure map/doc refs.
No new command files or adapter command registrations changed.
non_goals_preserved: Generated UI output is review evidence only; canonical truth remains KB/graph/audit sources.
No broad new product mode or new user-facing command was added.
remaining_risks: Pre-existing Control Room shell does not yet fully match newer Status/KB/Board/Map/Sessions product direction.
Generated-file changed warnings require commit/publication proof before task close.

risks: Status UI still sits inside the current pre-existing rail/inspector Control Room shell; TASK-013 did not attempt broader UI navigation redesign because that is outside non-goals.
Changed/generated-file warnings remain until commit/publication proof captures generated output.
